limitations: Priority is conditional on the inspected literature and indexed mathematical comparisons; unindexed older signed-root classifications could contain equivalent results. The facet sequence does not determine all face or Ehrhart coefficients. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional statement has a symbolic active-constraint and transfer-matrix proof. Exact rank and symbolic computational checks are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. The six-dimensional Möbius example is an explicit unimodular comparison, not a claimed realization in every dimension.
title: A parity-reflexivity law and exact facet sequence for signed-cycle root polytopes
